title: Expedition 67 - Axiom Mission 1 Undocking from International Space Station - April 24, 2022
description: Axiom Mission 1, the first private astronaut mission to the International Space Station, undocked from the orbiting laboratory with its crew of Michael Lopez-Alegria, Larry Connor, Mark Pathy, and Eytan Stibbe April 24. Prior to undocking, the crew provided farewell remarks and entered their Crew Dragon Endeavour for the trip back to Earth and a splashdown off the coast of Florida targeted for April 25 to complete 17 days in space.     Get the latest from NASA delivered every week. Subscribe here: www.nasa.gov/subscribe
via: the NASA Image and Video Library
